nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, let $\varphi : G \to \mathbb{C}$ satisfy $\varphi(1) = 1$ and $\varphi(xy) = \varphi(x)\varphi(y)$ for all $x, y \in G$ (a one-dimensional character), and let $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$. Writing $f \ast g$ for the convolution $(f \ast g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\, g(y^{-1} x)$, we have
nodes.title: Convolution theorem for one-dimensional characters

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and write $f \ast g$ for the convolution $(f \ast g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\, g(y^{-1} x)$ of functions on $G$. For all $f, g, h : G \to \mathbb{C}$ we have $(f \ast g) \ast h = f \ast (g \ast h)$.
nodes.title: Associativity of convolution

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and write $f \ast g$ for the convolution $(f \ast g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\, g(y^{-1} x)$ of functions on $G$. For all $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$ we have $f \ast g = g \ast f$.
nodes.title: Convolution on a finite abelian group is commutative

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, write $f \ast g$ for the convolution $(f \ast g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\, g(y^{-1} x)$ of functions on $G$, and let $\delta_1 : G \to \mathbb{C}$ be given by $\delta_1(1) = 1$ and $\delta_1(x) = 0$ for $x \neq 1$. Then $\delta_1 \ast f = f$ for every $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: The delta function at the identity is a left unit for convolution

nodes.summary: For a finite group $G$ and functions $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$, the convolution $f \ast g : G \to \mathbb{C}$ is defined by $(f \ast g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\, g(y^{-1} x)$ for $x \in G$.
nodes.title: Convolution on a finite group
